project_meta.title: What If The World Forgot How To Fight?

global_style.art_style: Minimalist hand-drawn 2D stickman animation in a clean indie webcomic style. Warm off-white paper background, bold slightly imperfect black ink outlines, simple expressive body language, limited earthy accent colors, and cinematic storytelling. Every human character must have a round white face with exactly two tiny simple solid-black dot eyes of identical size and spacing, no pupils, no irises, no eye whites, no highlights, no reflections, no eyelashes and no realistic eye details. Thin black stick limbs, simple curved mouths and clear readable poses. The recurring presenter wears a small red bow tie. Use many distinct illustrations, changing the camera angle, composition, character poses, locations and visual metaphors frequently. Each beat is a fresh image matching its narration, approximately every 2–3 seconds. Keep recurring character designs consistent. Depict conflict and war through non-graphic symbolic imagery, never gore. Vertical 9:16 composition.
global_style.negative_prompt: Photorealism, 3D rendering, anime, realistic human anatomy, detailed facial features, pupils, irises, eye whites, eye highlights, reflections, eyelashes, inconsistent eye designs, graphic violence, blood, wounds, gore, corpses, realistic weapons being used, glorification of violence, hateful symbols, national stereotypes, political propaganda, text-heavy images, captions, speech bubbles, watermarks, logos, cluttered compositions, overly bright neon colors.

beats.narration_text: एक सुबह पूरी दुनिया उठती है... और इंसान लड़ना ही भूल चुका होता है।
beats.prompt_action: A cinematic hand-drawn stickman illustration of a busy city street suddenly frozen in surprise. Groups of simple stickman people with round white faces and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes look confused at one another, while a symbolic broken sword lies harmlessly on the pavement. Buildings, trees and a cloudy morning sky in the background. Warm off-white paper, bold imperfect black ink outlines, earthy colors, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Establish the world where all humans have lost the ability and instinct to fight, while retaining their intelligence and ability to disagree.

beats.narration_text: ना गुस्से में मारपीट... ना बदला... ना किसी को चोट पहुँचाने का ख्याल।
beats.prompt_action: Two ordinary hand-drawn stickmen on a neighborhood sidewalk, one wearing a dark blue shirt and brown trousers, the other wearing a mustard-yellow top and dark trousers. Both have round white faces with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. One accidentally bumps into the other, but instead of aggression they step back and gesture apologetically. Simple expressive poses, warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: The blue-shirt young man and mustard-top young woman should retain their exact clothing and dot-eye designs.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन क्या इसका मतलब ये होगा कि दुनिया में हर समस्या खत्म हो जाएगी?
beats.prompt_action: The recurring hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie stands beside a giant question mark. Behind the presenter, a split scene shows peaceful neighbors on one side and two people arguing over a limited resource on the other. No physical violence. Off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the presenter identical, especially the two tiny black dot eyes and small red bow tie.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि लड़ाई भूलना और हर बात पर सहमत होना... दोनों अलग चीज़ें हैं।
beats.prompt_action: A dynamic two-panel hand-drawn illustration. On the left, two stickmen with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes calmly disagree while pointing at different ideas on a paper. On the right, another pair of stickmen work together to solve the same disagreement by shaking hands. No violence. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that disagreement still exists even when violence is no longer possible.

beats.narration_text: सबसे पहले बदलाव दिखेगा हमारी रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में।
beats.prompt_action: An overhead hand-drawn view of a neighborhood intersection with small shops, bicycles, trees and pedestrians. Several simple stickman people with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes move peacefully through the street. The scene feels unusually relaxed, with no threatening gestures. Warm earthy colors, off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep all characters visually simple with identical two-dot eyes.

beats.narration_text: मान लीजिए, सड़क पर किसी ने आपकी गाड़ी को टक्कर मार दी।
beats.prompt_action: A small hand-drawn traffic incident on a city street. A young man stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, dark blue shirt and brown trousers stands beside his bicycle, which has lightly bumped into a parked scooter. Another stickman in a mustard-yellow top looks surprised. No injuries, no damage beyond a slightly tilted mirror, no aggression. Vertical 9:16, bold black outlines and warm off-white paper.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the blue-shirt man and mustard-top character consistent.

beats.narration_text: आज शायद गाली-गलौज या हाथापाई हो जाती... लेकिन इस दुनिया में ऐसा नहीं होगा।
beats.prompt_action: The same young man with a round white face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, dark blue shirt and brown trousers pauses, takes a deep breath and gestures calmly toward the slightly damaged scooter. The other stickman with a mustard-yellow top listens. Their body language shows frustration without aggression. Hand-drawn black outlines, off-white paper, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Preserve the exact character clothing and simple dot-eye design.

beats.narration_text: दोनों शायद पुलिस बुलाएँगे, सबूत दिखाएँगे और बात कानून से सुलझेगी।
beats.prompt_action: Two simple stickman characters with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes stand beside a bicycle and scooter, calmly showing a small photograph of the incident to a friendly police officer in a simple blue uniform. No weapons or threatening gestures. The officer listens carefully and holds a small notebook. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Depict peaceful legal dispute resolution rather than physical retaliation.

beats.narration_text: घर में भाई-बहन का झगड़ा हो, तब भी मारपीट की जगह बातचीत करनी पड़ेगी।
beats.prompt_action: Inside a simple family living room, two sibling stickmen with round white faces and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes sit on opposite sides of a sofa, both wanting the same game controller. Their parent sits between them and encourages them to take turns. Warm earthy home decor, simple hand-drawn outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: All family members maintain the same simple two-dot eye design.

beats.narration_text: मतलब, गुस्सा तो रहेगा... लेकिन उसे हिंसा में बदलना इंसानों को याद ही नहीं होगा।
beats.prompt_action: A symbolic hand-drawn close-up of a simple stickman with a round white face and exactly two tiny black dot eyes standing beside a storm cloud that gradually transforms into a small peaceful cloud with a dove. The character's hands relax from clenched fists into open palms. Warm off-white paper, black ink outlines, muted blue and green accents, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use symbolic imagery to show anger being managed without violence.

beats.narration_text: अब सोचिए, जब दो लोग नहीं लड़ सकते... तो मोहल्ले और शहर कैसे बदलेंगे?
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn neighborhood community gathering in a small public square. Stickman neighbors with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes sit in a circle discussing a shared problem. Houses, trees and a small shop surround them. The atmosphere is cooperative but realistic, with some people raising hands to disagree. Off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show cooperation without suggesting that every disagreement disappears.

beats.narration_text: पड़ोसी पानी, पार्किंग या ज़मीन को लेकर बहस तो करेंगे।
beats.prompt_action: An overhead hand-drawn scene of two neighboring stickman families with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes discussing a boundary line between their homes. A water tap and a parked bicycle are nearby. Both families point toward a simple paper plan while maintaining distance. No physical aggression. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the conflict about ordinary limited resources and disagreements.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन समाधान के लिए पंचायत, अदालत और बातचीत का सहारा लेना पड़ेगा।
beats.prompt_action: A simple hand-drawn local mediation room. Two stickman neighbors with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes sit across a wooden table. A neutral mediator in a white shirt listens and examines a property map. Both sides have documents and open hands. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use calm mediation and legal institutions as the alternative to fighting.

beats.narration_text: स्कूलों में बच्चों को सिर्फ पढ़ाई नहीं, बल्कि मतभेद सुलझाना भी सिखाया जाएगा।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn classroom scene with a teacher stickman who has a round white face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, white shirt and dark trousers. Several students with matching simple dot eyes sit in groups, discussing a shared puzzle and listening to one another. A blackboard shows simple geometric shapes without readable text. Warm paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the teacher and students consistent with the simple stickman design.

beats.narration_text: लोग अपनी बात मनवाने के लिए ताकत नहीं, बल्कि तर्क और सबूत इस्तेमाल करेंगे।
beats.prompt_action: A close-up hand-drawn illustration of two stickman characters with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes presenting different documents, charts and sketches across a table. One character points to evidence while the other carefully studies it. Their expressions are simple and thoughtful. Bold black outlines, warm off-white paper, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Emphasize persuasion through evidence rather than intimidation.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन एक मुश्किल बाकी है... क्या हर इंसान ईमानदार भी हो जाएगा?
beats.prompt_action: The recurring presenter stickman with a round white face, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, thin black limbs and red bow tie looks thoughtfully at a large balance scale. One side contains a stack of coins and the other a paper contract. Behind him, two ordinary stickmen quietly negotiate. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Maintain the presenter's exact dot-eye design and red bow tie.

beats.narration_text: अब आते हैं सबसे बड़े सवाल पर... अगर देश ही युद्ध करना भूल जाएँ तो?
beats.prompt_action: A dramatic hand-drawn world map spread across a large table. Several simple stickman country leaders with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes stand around it. Their hands hover over the map as if facing a major decision. A symbolic broken sword rests beside the map. No flags, no national stereotypes, no readable labels. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Shift the story from personal violence to international conflict.

beats.narration_text: ना सेनाएँ हमला करेंगी, ना मिसाइलें दागी जाएँगी, ना शहरों पर बम गिरेंगे।
beats.prompt_action: A non-graphic symbolic hand-drawn aerial view of a peaceful city beneath a clear sky. In the distant sky, faint crossed-out silhouettes of missiles and military aircraft dissolve into harmless clouds, while people walk safely through parks and streets below. No explosions, no destruction, no national symbols. Bold black outlines, muted blue and green accents, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Represent the absence of large-scale attacks without depicting actual destruction.

beats.narration_text: सीमाओं पर सैनिक शायद लड़ने की जगह निगरानी और बचाव का काम करेंगे।
beats.prompt_action: A peaceful hand-drawn border checkpoint in a mountainous landscape. Two military personnel stickmen with round white faces, exactly two tiny black dot eyes, muted olive uniforms and simple helmets calmly guide civilians and inspect a crossing. No weapons, no aggressive posture. A small medical tent and supply vehicle are visible nearby. Warm off-white paper, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Military characters should appear in humanitarian and protective roles.

beats.narration_text: जो पैसा हथियारों और युद्ध में जाता, उसका बड़ा हिस्सा शिक्षा, अस्पताल और रिसर्च में लग सकता था।
beats.prompt_action: A three-panel hand-drawn illustration showing possible peaceful investments: a newly built school with happy stickman students, a hospital where a doctor cares for a patient, and a scientific laboratory where inventors examine a telescope and scientific models. All characters have round white faces and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. No military equipment. Warm earthy palette, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Present the benefits as possible uses of resources, not guaranteed outcomes.

beats.narration_text: शायद देशों के बीच मुकाबला युद्ध से नहीं, तकनीक, व्यापार और खेलों से होता।
beats.prompt_action: A lively hand-drawn montage in one vertical frame showing three forms of international competition: scientists from different countries collaborating around a telescope, merchants exchanging goods at a shipping port, and stickman athletes racing on a track. All human faces are round white circles with exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes. No flags or national stereotypes. Warm off-white paper, bold outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show healthy competition and cooperation between societies.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन दुनिया से युद्ध खत्म होने का मतलब ये नहीं कि गरीबी और अन्याय भी खत्म हो जाएँगे।
beats.prompt_action: A thoughtful hand-drawn split composition. On one side, a peaceful city with no military conflict. On the other, a poor neighborhood where a family waits near an empty food basket while a large wealthy building stands in the background. Every person has a round white face with exactly two tiny black dot eyes. No violence. Muted earthy colors, off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make clear that peace does not automatically solve inequality, poverty or injustice.

beats.narration_text: और यहाँ एक बहुत बड़ा सवाल उठता है... अगर कोई देश दूसरों का शोषण करे तो?
beats.prompt_action: A close-up hand-drawn world map on a wooden conference table. Two simple stickman leaders with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes point toward a disputed region on the map. Other delegates watch carefully. No flags, no labels, no threatening gestures. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Show that international disputes can still exist even without warfare.

beats.narration_text: लड़ाई न कर पाने पर भी कोई देश व्यापार रोक सकता है, दबाव बना सकता है या नियम तोड़ सकता है।
beats.prompt_action: A hand-drawn international port with cargo ships, stacked shipping containers and merchants standing beside a closed trade gate. Two groups of stickmen with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes hold conflicting trade documents across a table. The scene suggests economic pressure and disagreement without violence. Warm off-white paper, earthy colors, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Use trade barriers and economic pressure as examples of non-military conflict.

beats.narration_text: इसलिए दुनिया को सिर्फ लड़ना भूलना नहीं, बल्कि न्याय और सहयोग सीखना भी पड़ेगा।
beats.prompt_action: Several stickman delegates with round white faces and exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes sit around a circular international negotiation table. They study shared documents, maps and proposals. A small white dove carrying an olive branch sits on the table. No national flags or political symbols. Warm off-white paper, bold black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Focus on fair agreements, cooperation and shared responsibility.

beats.narration_text: क्योंकि शांति सिर्फ हथियार न चलाने से नहीं, एक-दूसरे के अधिकारों की इज़्ज़त करने से बनती है।
beats.prompt_action: A close-up hand-drawn illustration of two ordinary stickmen with round white faces and exactly two tiny black dot eyes shaking hands across a small table. Behind them, other community members stand together holding a simple symbolic olive branch. Their body language conveys dignity and mutual respect. Warm off-white paper, black ink outlines, muted green accents, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Make the emotional focus mutual respect, not forced agreement.

beats.narration_text: शायद ऐसी दुनिया में इंसान की सबसे बड़ी ताकत उसकी समझदारी होती।
beats.prompt_action: The recurring stickman presenter with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and a small red bow tie stands on a small hill overlooking a peaceful town. Below, people cooperate in a school, a hospital, a marketplace and a public park. A white dove with an olive branch flies above. Warm golden sunlight, bold imperfect black outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: Keep the presenter identical and show a hopeful but realistic peaceful society.

beats.narration_text: लेकिन सच बताओ... अगर इंसान लड़ना भूल जाए, तो क्या दुनिया सच में बेहतर बन जाएगी?
beats.prompt_action: The recurring hand-drawn stickman presenter with a round white face, exactly two tiny solid-black dot eyes, thin black stick limbs and small red bow tie looks directly at the viewer with a thoughtful expression. Behind the presenter, a dramatic split scene shows a peaceful community on one side and a tense international negotiation table on the other. A small question mark floats overhead. Warm off-white paper, bold black ink outlines, vertical 9:16.
beats.session_delta_prompt: End with the exact same presenter face, dot eyes and red bow tie. Leave uncluttered space around the character.
